concerns.text: FR-001 mandates downloading 'FlavorDB chemical matrix' and 'Counterfactual Recipe Generation dataset'. The tasks (T012, T051, T013) exclusively implement fetching 'Recipe1M' and 'Ratings' datasets. No task exists to fetch or process the FlavorDB or Counterfactual datasets required by the current spec text.

FR-001b requires verifying the 'Counterfactual Recipe Generation dataset' for independent sensory labels. Tasks T012 and T042 verify 'Recipe1M ratings' schema. There is no task to verify the Counterfactual dataset as mandated by the spec.

FR-004 requires calculating cosine similarity between 'chemical vectors' (from FlavorDB). Tasks T016 and T013 implement similarity using 'Recipe1M text/visual embeddings'. No task exists to fetch FlavorDB chemical vectors or compute similarity based on them.

FR-006 mandates the dependent variable be derived from 'independent sensory evaluation scores'. Tasks T013c and T022 derive labels from 'Recipe1M ratings' (same source as predictors). No task exists to fetch or process independent sensory scores.

FR-008 requires a 'likelihood-ratio test' against a null model. Tasks T024b and T030 implement 'Partial Correlation' and 'Bootstrap/Permutation' tests. No task exists to perform the specific Likelihood-Ratio Test required by FR-008.

SC-001 requires measuring 'independent explanatory power' via likelihood-ratio test p-values. The tasks implement 'associative strength' via partial correlation (T024b). No task maps to the SC-001 metric definition in the spec.

SC-002 requires measuring 'generalization performance' against an independent dataset. The tasks implement 'cross-validation within the corpus' (T030b). No task exists to evaluate generalization to an independent dataset as required by SC-002.

Task T024b references 'Plan: SC-001' but implements a method (Partial Correlation) that contradicts the current spec's SC-001 definition (Likelihood-Ratio Test). The task description fails to explicitly state that it invalidates the original FR-008/SC-001 acceptance criteria, creating a traceability gap.

Task T012 verifies 'Recipe1M' and 'Ratings' datasets but does not explicitly document the removal of the 'Counterfactual Recipe Generation' dataset requirement from FR-001b, risking confusion about which dataset is the verified source.
